data.name: Powerful Healer
data.description: You can add power to a cure spell as you cast it. As a swift action, you can treat any cure spell as if it were empowered (as the Empower Spell feat), causing it to heal 50%% more damage (or deal 50%% more damage if used against undead). This ability doesn't stack with itself or the Empower Spell feat.
